# Hi, I'm Louis.

<p class="tagline">I'm turning a lifelong love of football into a career in data analytics. I'm a West Ham season ticket holder currently studying a MSc Data Analytics in Football. I'm hosting my work here and looking for opportunities for real world analytics experience</p>

[See my projects](projects/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg} [Read the blog](blog/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-lg}
:::

## What I do

My main interests are opposition analysis, scouting analysis and predictive modeling using expected goals. I use **Python** and **Power BI** to ask practical questions about the game: who should a club look at, how does a team really play, and what should a coach take from the next match.
